title: Automotive Undercar Specialist
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Automotive Undercar Specialist - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS975/AS975C/CE975
outcomes: Demonstrate personal and shop safety procedures neededto safely work in an automotive shop environment.
Demonstrate the ability to diagnose, service and repairautomotive suspension and steering systems usingindustry approved equipment.
Demonstrate the ability to diagnose, service and repair automotive brake systems systems using industry approved equipment.
Utilize common shop equipment to correct wheel alignment and vibration concerns.
Demonstrate ability to test and diagnose electronic suspension, steering, and braking systems found on modern automobiles.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement. The heading appears three times with slightly different code suffixes (AS975/AS975C/CE975 and AS975/AS975B/AS975C/CE975). The requirements list is shared by both awards.
The Program Learning Outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole. The certificate shares them, so they are recorded here.
Outcomes are copied exactly as printed, including run-together words ('neededto', 'repairautomotive', 'usingindustry') and the repeated 'systems systems'.
Every course is labeled '( Historical )' in the catalog. A reviewer should check whether these courses are still active for 2026-2027.
The catalog prints codes with hyphens (AUT-4A). These match the closed-list codes (AUT 4A, etc.).
The catalog titles AUT-50 'Automotive Principles'; the state file has 'Automotive Principle'.
The general education statement applies only to the A.S. degree, so ge_pattern is null for this certificate.
